lead.headline: Waivers passed without a claim; Jefferson and McLaurin are still on your bench
lead.deck: Nothing was reported overnight on either receiver, and Wednesday's practice is this afternoon. Set both swaps now. Metcalf cleared and is free; Thursday is still the day for him.
lead.body: Start with the bad news about your own players: there is still no report behind Justin Jefferson's ankle or Terry McLaurin's hamstring, and both are still in bench slots on a roster that is 0–4. The projection lineup is 124.3 and the lineup you have set is 115.1. The only new words on Jefferson came on Minnesota radio on Tuesday. The Star Tribune's Ben Goessling expects him to 'push to play' and the team to be 'a little bit cautious this week'; Kevin O'Connell said 'we want to be smart'. He has not practised since 27 Sep. Dan Quinn promised an update on McLaurin for Wednesday and it has not come yet. The rule hasn't changed: the projection sets the lineup, so Jefferson goes in for Jordan Addison at 18.6 against 11.4 and McLaurin for Alvin Kamara in the flex at 13.2 against 11.2. All four play at 11:00 on Sunday, so each benched man is the fallback and nothing locks early. Check the inactive lists at 09:30. The waiver run processed at 01:00 with no claim from you, which was the recommendation, and it cost nothing: DK Metcalf went unclaimed and is a free agent. Leaguemates took Tucker Kraft, Tyreek Hill and Deshaun Watson, and Talla Metralla dropped Trevor Lawrence for T.J. Hockenson at 06:25. None of that touches your lineup. Thursday is the day for Metcalf: Addison's seat is a week old then, and if Jefferson has practised he no longer needs a fallback. ESPN has you at 49% against Los Gigantes de Teca. Ja'Marr Chase, their best player, is still in the concussion protocol, and the AP says he 'may miss' Sunday.
